# TARA Brain Atlas and framing: index

Start here for anything atlas, anatomy, brain view, DSM wording or purpose-and-limits. Quickest lookup: `npm run atlas:where -- <words>`. The source of truth is `src/scripts/atlas-map/atlas-map.json`; this page is generated from it and states structure only. PR state and merge order live in the planning epic; the 89 open items are in `docs/atlas/FOLLOW-UPS.md`.

Paths are from the repository root. "(pending #N)" marks a record whose files live on that open framing PR, not yet here.

## What it is

The TARA Brain Atlas replaces hand-drawn brain pictures with cited, licence-cleared atlas geometry tied to QIF regions, pathways, devices and techniques, shown in the explorer at /atlas/anatomy/ and as a region view mounted on other pages. Every mapping is AI-drafted and unreviewed until the owner records a review, and the site states that and its other limits wherever the data appears.

## Checks

| Id | Script | Guards | CI |
|---|---|---|---|
| unit-tests | `npm run test` | Parsers, cross-checks, committed-file guards, map guards, this feature map and its generated pages, limit-copy snapshot | `.github/workflows/security.yml` job `audit` |
| unit-tests-deploy | `npm run test` | The same suite again before every deploy of main | `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` job `deploy` |
| pipeline-tests | `npm run atlas:test` | Pipeline stages on synthetic fixtures and the manifest code hash; CI runs the standard-library subset with pytest | `.github/workflows/security.yml` job `audit` |
| build | `npm run build` | The index and endpoints build; a malformed data file stops the build | `.github/workflows/security.yml` job `audit` |
| post-build | `npm run check:post-build` | Served files equal the manifest; attribution wording; no anatomy in a Lab page; first-load budgets; three.js behind the button | `.github/workflows/security.yml` job `audit` |
| type-check | `npm run type-check` | Types; needs a build first in a fresh checkout | `.github/workflows/security.yml` job `audit` |
| lab-budget | `npm run check:lab-budget` | First-load budgets alone, for local runs; part of check:post-build | not in CI |
| anatomy-payload | `npm run check:anatomy-payload` | No anatomy rows in built pages, alone; part of check:post-build | not in CI |
| health | `npm run health` | Propagation: datalake, query tables and pages in sync | not in CI |
| atlas-docs-check | `npm run atlas:docs:check` | docs/atlas/INDEX.md and FOLLOW-UPS.md match this map; also asserted inside npm test | not in CI |
| generated-check | `npm run generated:check` | Generated registrar sections, and the purpose-and-limits blocks once #181 merges | `.github/workflows/registrar-sync-check.yml` job `validate-registrar` |
| purpose-check | `npm run purpose:check` (pending #181) | Markdown purpose-and-limits blocks match src/data/purpose-and-limits.json | not in CI |
